notablePrerequisites: An opponent has at least seven cards in hand.
description:
Activate Soulfire Grand Master by paying {2}{U/R}{U/R}, causing you to put the next instant or sorcery card you cast from your hand this turn into your hand as it resolves.
Cast Jeska's Will by paying {2}{R}, adding at least seven {R} and returning it to your hand.
Repeat.
If an opponent has eight or more cards in their hand, this combo nets infinite red mana.
If you control a commander, you may choose both of Jeska's WIll's modes to exile your library.
